newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-VIERI MARKS DEBUT WITH ITALY'S 1,000TH GOAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VIERI MARKS DEBUT WITH ITALY'S 1,000TH GOAL.

text.p: Christian Vieri celebrated his senior debut on Saturday by scoring his country's 1,000th international goal as Italy overcame Moldova 3-0 in a World Cup qualifier to go top of European group two.

The result in Trieste, the northeastern birthplace of Italian coach Cesare Maldini, left Italy with a maximum 12 points from their four matches and could only be depressing news for main group rivals England.
Itay are now three points clear of England who have nine from the same number of games.
Maldini's son Paolo gave his father a perfect homecoming present with a superb goal in the 24th minute.

Milan team mate Demetrio Albertini, near the corner flag to the left of goal, fed the ball to Maldini who threaded his way into the area past two defenders. He feinted past a third and slotted the ball diagonally past Denis Romanenco.

Chelsea striker Gianfranco Zola, who scored the winner against England at Wembley last month, scored the second a minute before half time when Romanenco, well out of goal, parried a shot from Dino Baggio.
The ball fell to Zola who had a simple shot.

Juventus striker Vieri struck four minutes into the second half with his left foot for the 1,000th goal scored by Italy since Pietro Lana grabbed their first 542 matches ago in a 6-2 win over France in Milan in 1910.
